text: so will it capture this message im sending right now
resolution: Answered live: yes — the UserPromptSubmit hook captured this very message the moment it was sent (it cleared the 40-char noise threshold), stored it byte-verbatim as req_0004 with this session's id and captureMode hook, and the capture line landed in the worker's context before the reply was even written. No code changed; the question itself became the proof of the mechanism it asked about.
